name: Blister strip of metoprolol
description: A beta blocker. Lowers blood pressure and steadies the heart under stress.
notes: Blood pressure and heart rate have no content fields yet.

name: Bag of methamphetamine
description: A powerful stimulant. Keeps sleep away and sharpens focus at a cost to health. Highly addictive.
notes: Not skipped as loose powder: it is found in a zip bag, so the model is the bag, as cocaine's is. The high-grade variant shares the model and differs in its effects. The bag is plastic-clear, drawn opaque in the tiles; the frosted shards sit on top of it so they show anyway. Residential stands in for street loot, for which no usage tag exists.

name: Bottle of mugwort oil
description: An essential oil pressed from mugwort. Taken with water, it clears out gut parasites.
notes: Crafted by the player, so usage is empty. The whole bottle is the item, as with antiseptic: a 50 ml amber dropper bottle of oil. The tape strip marks it as homemade. Parasites have no content field yet.

name: Case of contact lenses
description: A pair of soft lenses in a twin case of saline. Correct eyesight while worn; thrown away once worn out.
notes: All the lens kinds (short and long sight, bifocal, light-adjusting, daily and weekly) look the same in their case, so they ride on one model as variants and differ only in stats. The row is a twin lens case. category is medical for want of an eyewear category; vision correction has no content field yet.

name: Bottle of naproxen
description: A long-lasting painkiller. Eases pain and swelling.
notes: The green label and cap set it apart from the other white tablet bottles. The analgesic numbers belong to the refactor; it should outlast aspirin and share its group.

name: Blister card of nicotine gum
description: Mint gum laced with nicotine. Eases the craving for a smoke.
notes: The green print band stands for mint. Nicotine and craving have no content fields yet.

name: Nicotine pouch
description: A small pouch of nicotine salts to tuck under the lip. Eases the craving for a smoke.
notes: One pouch is one item, while the model draws the round can of twenty, hence the stack. The white catch on the lid holds used pouches, which sets the can apart from the chewing tobacco tin. Nicotine has no content field yet.

name: Bottle of night cough syrup
description: Night-time cold medicine. Eases coughing and aches, and brings on sleep.
notes: The id avoids the brand name. The whole bottle is the item, matching the day syrup. plastic-green stands in for green syrup through a clear bottle; no green see-through finish exists. Colds and drowsiness have no content fields yet.

name: Vial of oxycodone
description: A strong opioid painkiller. Highly addictive.
notes: The white cap sets it apart from the prescription sedative's blue one. Its analgesic numbers belong to the refactor, in the opioid group with codeine but stronger.

name: Red capsule
description: A thumbnail-sized red gel capsule with something dark shifting inside. Unlabelled and experimental.
notes: The name describes the thing rather than a brand. A single capsule is what a player picks up, so the model is the capsule itself at the finest 2 mm grain, which leaves it blocky at 11 mm across. The gel is see-through red in the game and shows the dark core. Found in labs; Medical and Tier3 stand in until a lab usage tag exists. Its effect is for the refactor.

name: Carton of sleeping pills
description: A tranquilliser for insomnia. Brings on sleep. Habit-forming.
notes: The dark blue carton with its yellow moon sets it apart from the tablet bottles. Sleep has no content field yet.

name: Vial of poppy painkillers
description: Pain tablets refined from poppy. Strong relief without the haze. Habit-forming.
notes: Crafted by the player, so usage is empty. The brown tablets inside show only in the game, where the glass is clear; the tape strip marks it as homemade.

name: Tin of poppy sleeping tablets
description: A sleeping draught pressed into tablets from poppy seeds. Brings on sleep. Habit-forming.
notes: Crafted by the player, so usage is empty. A tin rather than another vial keeps it apart from the poppy painkiller on the ground.

name: Bottle of poppy cough syrup
description: Cough syrup brewed from poppy. Eases coughing and brings on sleep.
notes: Crafted by the player, so usage is empty. The whole reused glass bottle is the item, as with antiseptic. The body shows the dark syrup as if through glass; cork and tape mark it as homemade.

name: Bottle of heartburn syrup
description: A pink chalky syrup. Settles an upset stomach and holds back vomiting.
notes: The id avoids the brand name. The whole 240 ml bottle is the item, as with antiseptic. paint-terracotta stands in for the pink bottle, which no finish matches. Nausea has no content field yet.
